response.description:
As
organizations deploy more agentic applications and MCP-based tools, enforcing
consistent safety and compliance policies across agent interactions becomes
increasingly important. Many teams today rely on fragmented or custom
implementations for content filtering and policy enforcement, creating
operational complexity and increasing risk.  With
this update, Azure API Management extends content safety capabilities to MCP
tools and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) APIs, enabling centralized enforcement of safety
controls across agent-based workflows.  This
allows organizations to:  
 Apply consistent content safety
     policies across models, MCP tools, and A2A agent
     interactions  
 Reduce the risk of unsafe,
     harmful, or non-compliant outputs  
 Centralize governance and policy
     enforcement for agentic systems  By
bringing content safety controls into the API management layer, Azure API
Management helps organizations operate AI agents and MCP ecosystems
with stronger governance, compliance, and enterprise-grade safeguards.  Learn
more.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure API Management now supports content safety controls for MCP and A2A APIs.
